meta.title: Burlington Capital Partners — Equity for owner-built companies

lede: Burlington Capital Partners invests in family, founder and operator owned companies in food, supply chain, business and consumer services and other mission-critical industries.

thesis.text: We are equity investors who help lower middle market companies grow. We look for businesses with recurring demand, run by great people with aligned visions for growth and integrity.

stats.k: Minimum EBITDA, with a history of profitability
Private equity investments completed by the team

steps.title: Customer first.
steps.text: We invest in B2B and B2C companies that have a customer-first mentality, and we love businesses with recurring demand.

steps.title: People first.
steps.text: Private investing is most successful when it is rooted in great working relationships. It all comes down to the people.

steps.title: Partner first.
steps.text: We see sellers as partners. Our ideal partners are family or founder-owned businesses seeking their first outside investment, for growth or for succession planning.

focusIntro: Burlington invests in US-based, profitable lower middle market companies owned by families, founders or operators.

criteria.v: A history of profitability, low cyclicality and well-positioned competitive advantages.
Family, operator or founder-owned, ideally seeking a first outside investment for growth or succession planning.

sectorsText: Food and beverage, industrial services, business and consumer services, mission-critical supply chain and enthusiast markets.
pillars: We invest in B2B and B2C companies that have a customer-first mentality.
Private investing is most successful when it is rooted in great working relationships.
We view sellers as our partners, ideally family or founder-owned businesses seeking their first outside investment.
portfolioIntro: Family and founder-owned companies in garage door services, pallets and crates, and food ingredients.

portfolio.name: RS Boes Holdings
portfolio.desc: Franchisee and consolidator of Precision Garage Door, one of the largest garage door service providers in the U.S. and a part of the Neighborly family.

portfolio.name: Martin Pallet and Hinchcliff Products
portfolio.desc: Manufacturers of custom, specialty wood pallets and crates.

portfolio.name: Sokol
portfolio.desc: Liquid food manufacturer of custom ingredients and ready-to-eat products. Sold to Solina in 2025.

teamIntro: Careers across private equity, venture capital, investment banking and the general management of manufacturing and food businesses.

team.name: Michael Baldwin
team.title: Partner
bio: Michael most recently worked at a growth equity investment firm with $10B+ AUM. His career spans private equity and venture capital investing, corporate strategy and investment banking.
He took a portfolio company public at a $525M enterprise value, ran go-to-market strategy for a $2.5B foodservice P&L, and has completed 20+ private equity investments.
He holds an MBA from Northwestern University (Kellogg) and a BS from Indiana University (Kelley).

team.name: Tim Novak
team.title: Partner
bio: Tim most recently led the investment in and management of a multi-site packaging manufacturing business, overseeing two greenfield buildouts and startups.

Before that he served in leadership roles at a private equity backed global baking business. His career spans private equity investing, general management of manufacturing operations and corporate development in the food industry.
He holds an MBA from Northwestern University (Kellogg) and a BA from the University of Dayton.
